author: Tazz
body:
Hello

Myself and Jive want to remake the terrible map Sentry. We all know that the last version was terrible, however we want suggestions. So far we have acknowledged that the map was way to big and closed off, however what else made the map terrible? Should we add something to fight for in middle. 

Please leave suggestions below so me and Jive can make Sentry great ;o

Regards

Tazz and Jive

replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
Initial thought: Give more arrows for excessive amounts of bowspam :P

*But yeah I agree with above statements to add spawners

*Make mid less of a "no mans land" possibly add some cover to hide behind as it felt way to open.

*That little bit on the side could be replicated on the other side maybe, and possibly have a spawner in the middle of those alley bits. Maybe have one or two gapple spawners in mid and have arrow spawners on those side lanes?

*Maybe add a few more positions. The map is named sentry after all, so possibly some archer towers or turrets would be appropriate. Cause the current map only has 1 position you basically see people go - behind those wall thingies either on the side lane and up top on their side. I think adding some more angles would make bow spam more fun and actually make people hit someone once in a while cause you were basically immune to arrow fire behind those wall things. I once attacked someone in Clash of Clans for 3 minutes on my iPod during a tournament, came back and was still full health sitting behind the wall.

*I think if there was a scorebox, people might be more inclined to push the enemy team. Possibly have it under mid, where that tunnel thing starts cause thats basically useless as it is. It gives people an incentive to venture into no mans land and will forcibly stop stalemates.
